# Chess Checker

> Chess Checker is a free web app for turning chessboard screenshots into FEN positions for post-game analysis, chess puzzles and study.

## Main pages

- https://chesschecker.com/ — Interactive Chess Checker app. Upload or paste a chess screenshot, review the detected position, correct pieces if needed, copy FEN, and open the position in Lichess or Coachess.
- https://chesschecker.com/analyse-chess-moves.html — Explanation of how to analyse chess moves and positions from screenshots.

## Capabilities

- Convert chess screenshots and chessboard images to FEN.
- Recognise board orientation and estimate the side to move.
- Show a confidence score for recognised positions.
- Provide an editable visual chessboard for correcting misread pieces.
- Identify a selection of common chess openings.
- Save recent positions locally on the user's device.
- Create shareable position links.
- Send positions to Lichess or Coachess for analysis.

## Intended use

Chess Checker is intended for post-game review, puzzles, coaching and chess study. It is not intended to provide prohibited outside assistance during live human games.

## Product details

- Name: Chess Checker
- Website: https://chesschecker.com/
- Price: Free
- Account required: No
- Category: Chess analysis utility / screenshot-to-FEN converter
